peak.description: Held peak, null when none. Derived from the history of value (time dependent): by the host when it owns the state, otherwise by the front end (HOST-004).

messages.description: Heartbeat, sent every _heartbeat seconds when the host announces liveness.

_kind.description: Front-end renderer identifier; each widget schema fixes it with a const.

mode.description: "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only.

label.description: Plain text, never interpreted as HTML (SEC-002).

theme.description: "auto": the style decides; "system": the host page or the operating system (STYLE-007).

skin.description: Replaceable drawing parts: part name -> SVG source, sanitized (STYLE-005, STYLE-006).

_session.description: Identity of the host session that owns the state. Non-empty: the host is authoritative for derived traits and may announce heartbeats (HOST-003, HOST-004). Empty (default): the front end computes derived traits itself.

_heartbeat.description: Heartbeat period announced by the host, in seconds. 0 (default): no stale-data detection. With a non-empty _session and a period > 0, the host sends {"type": "hb", "session": _session} every period (ROB-001, HOST-003).

cursors.description: Cursors {x, name, color} (CHART-104). Dragged or typed by the operator, also on indicators; a host may complete a missing name as C<n> (Python does).

cursor_values.description: Readout of the cursors for the host program, {name, x, values}, computed by the host from its data. The front end draws its own readout and does not read this trait.

annotations.description: Text annotations {x, y, text, color} in data coordinates (CHART-105).

export.description: Offer CSV, PNG and SVG downloads in the toolbar (CHART-107).

value.description: Latest sample of each trace, written by the host with each append.

history.description: Points kept and shown per trace.

update_mode.description: strip: continuous scroll; scope: fill then restart; sweep: a moving cursor overwrites the oldest data.

y_min.description: Y range when autoscale_y is off; set by the operator with the axes panel.

y_scale.description: Scale of the left Y axis; on a logarithmic axis values <= 0 are not drawn, and a range reaching 0 or below starts at y_max / 1000 (IND-117).

y2_min.description: Range of the secondary axis on the right, for the traces with axis right, when autoscale_y2 is off (IND-117).

y2_unit.description: Unit of the secondary axis, shown under it and after the values of its traces under a cursor.

paused.description: Freeze the display; samples keep arriving (CHART-009).

dt.description: Sample interval in x-axis units; 0 is shown as 1.

traces.description: Optional style of each trace {name, color, width, visible, axis}.
